Priya: Quick async check — quarterly OKR milestone sync. Can each pillar lead post what actually shipped this sprint, what slipped, and immediate next step (owner + ETA)? Pls keep to single-line per person. thanks :pray:

Alex: Runtime — shipped v2 batching opt, reduced p95 by ~120ms. Slipped: autoscale policy tweak (blocked by infra quota). Next: Sam to follow up with infra quota request, ETA Tue EOD.

Sam: Confirming — I opened PR with quota request: https://git.internal/rfq/42 — pinged infra. ETA Tue. Also CR ping for batching tests @Maya.

Maya: CR'd batching tests, left two comments on perf harness. Will re-run when infra quota in. Expect green by Wed.

Jun: Product infra — shipped canary for model routing, observed small mem leak on longer sequences. Slipped: rollout to EU region. Next: Jun -> ops to triage memory leak, ETA Thu.

Priya: Noted. Who owns the EU rollout blocker? @Jun

Jun: Ops owns final deploy; I'll coordinate. @Alex can we set a temporary fallback routing to v1 in EU while we patch?

Alex: Yep, we can route EU to v1. I'll add a canary flag. Should be quick.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for routing-v1-fallback in eu-west-1 at 2025-05-10T14:23Z :rocket:

Priya: Action items summary — Sam: infra quota PR (ETA Tue); Maya: perf harness fixes (ETA Wed); Jun+Ops: memory leak triage + EU fallback (ETA Thu); Alex: add fallback flag (in flight). I'll consolidate into the milestone doc and ping execs. :ballot_box_with_check:

Alex: Also FYI — one CR pending on model-quant PR, owner @Jun, could affect cost OKR if delayed.

Jun: ack, will prioritize quant PR today.

Priya: Thanks all — if anything slips, update thread with owner/ETA.
